description: Initialize or resume a lossless project history archive (docs/history-session/). Call once near the start of a conversation with the user's verbatim first request as initial_user_input. Echo the returned session_key on later calls in this chat. Without host/explicit session_key, the server mints a new hs_<uuid> handle and opens a new archive (does not merge into a shared project-active file). Never invent a key. Returns bounded state (≤64 KiB). Disable with MCP_HISTORY_SESSION=0|false|off.

create_if_missing.description: Create archive when missing; default true

initial_user_input.description: Verbatim first user request for this conversation

mode.description: resume (default) reuses the archive for this session_key; fresh always creates a new archive

project_root.description: Project root; omit to use workspace resolution

session_key.description: Echo the server-minted handle from a previous bootstrap in this conversation. Omit only on the first call; omitting later opens a new archive instead of merging.

title.description: Archive title when creating a new session

name: history_session_bootstrap
